supersedes: v1 at 7915734df, whose per-builder line numbers were wrong for the reason below
generatedBy: Captain, second measurement, after VF31 found the first one measuring the wrong line
theFinding: A builder's refusal path prints "Nothing was written." while output files are already on disk.

whatWasWrongWithV1.theError: I took the first write to be the first line matching writeFileSync(. In a builder that wraps writing in a helper -- const writeJson = (rel, value) => { ... fs.writeFileSync(...) } -- that line is the helper's DEFINITION, near the top of the file. So almost every refusal downstream counted as 'after the first write'.
whatWasWrongWithV1.howItShowed: The record read 25 of 25 late refusals for ar-cs-possession-seal-set with firstWriteAtLine 404, which is the writeJson definition, not a call.
whatWasWrongWithV1.foundBy: VF31, which read the line rather than the number
whatWasWrongWithV1.whatChanged: This version finds every helper whose body writes, then takes the earliest CALL to one of them, or the earliest direct writeFileSync that is not part of a definition.

theHeadlineDidNotMove.andThatIsWorthSayingPlainly: 14 of 24 both times. The per-builder line numbers were wrong and the corpus-level answer was not. A number can be right for the wrong reason, and it was.

method: source order of every fail() CALL against the first write CALL. Source order remains a PROXY for execution order and is still stated as one -- a call site above the first write can run after it, and one below can be unreachable.
whatIsNotClaimed: That any of these builders has actually refused after writing. Nothing here establishes a single such run. It establishes that the guarantee the sentence gives is not one the code structure can keep.

oneBuilderIsNowREPAIRED.andThatIsCorrect: FIX01 moved every check that does not need bytes on disk above the first report write -- twelve files used to precede the newest guards, four do now -- and those four are the fixtures the guards must read. Refusing after writing them is unavoidable, not a defect.
oneBuilderIsNowREPAIRED.whatMakesItRepaired: the message no longer denies it. fail() prints a ledger every write appends to as it happens, naming each file and saying they are the partial output of a run that then refused, are not a packet, and are not to be read as one. "Nothing was written." still prints when the ledger is empty, where it is true.
oneBuilderIsNowREPAIRED.verifiedBy: VF31, which drove fail() directly -- empty ledger prints the old sentence, after two writes it names both files -- and confirmed there is no other write channel in the file.
oneBuilderIsNowREPAIRED.soTheRemedyIsNotAlwaysToMoveTheRefusal: Where a guard must read what was written, the honest fix is a truthful message, not an earlier refusal.

notFixedHere: Thirteen builders still print a sentence their structure cannot guarantee. FIX01 correctly did not sweep them; it holds one grant. Recorded for scheduling.
grantsNothing: This records a measurement of the builders' refusal paths.
